# Results (generated by examples/results.py)

Recorded on x86_64 Linux, x86_64; Accellera SystemC 3.0.2, g++ 13.3.0. Every number in the README and in deck SimEng 03 comes from here.

## 1. The AT model against the SimPy model on the same traces

SimPy: FHE_Accelerator_Sim in worst-case clocking mode. SystemC: the approximately-timed model with the explicit tie-break (oldest operation first among simultaneous requests), time resolution 1 fs.

| case | HE ops | SimPy horizon | SystemC horizon, relative difference | largest op-end difference | ops differing by more than 1 ps | HBM bytes identical | unit busy-time difference / horizon |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| one HMult (ark) | 1 | 0.2634 ms | -2.2e-16 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| one HRot (ark) | 1 | 0.2207 ms | -6.7e-16 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| bootstrap, ARK-class | 203 | 13.9354 ms | +6.4e-15 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| bootstrap + Min-KS/seeded/OTF, ARK-class | 233 | 7.1914 ms | +4.4e-16 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| bootstrap, small digital | 203 | 17.4644 ms | +9.5e-15 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| bootstrap + Min-KS/seeded/OTF, small digital | 233 | 26.6480 ms | +8.9e-16 | 0 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |
| bootstrap, ARK-class, 1 MiB chunks | 203 | 13.9734 ms | +9.8e-14 | 26.7 us | 19 | yes | 2e-17 |
| 4 bootstraps, ARK-class | 812 | 55.7134 ms | +1.2e-13 | 7 fs | 0 | yes | 0e+00 |

Costs, scratchpad decisions and byte counts are identical by construction (the same formulas in the same floating-point order), so the only freedom left is the order of simultaneous requests. With 1 MiB chunks there are four times as many HBM transactions and more exact ties, and in some of them SimPy's order (its event-scheduling order) is not oldest-operation-first; those operations finish earlier or later while the horizon, busy times and bytes still agree.

## 2. Tie-breaking: explicit against the kernel's process order

`--tiebreak kernel` grants a free resource to whichever process asks first in the SystemC kernel's execution order, which IEEE 1666 leaves to the implementation (here Accellera SystemC 3.0.2). `--tiebreak oldest` waits until the instant has settled and grants the oldest operation's request.

| case | kernel order: ops that differ from SimPy | horizon difference | explicit: ops that differ | horizon difference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| bootstrap, ARK-class | 6 of 203 | +6.4e-15 | 0 | +6.4e-15 |
| bootstrap, small digital | 18 of 203 | +9.5e-15 | 0 | +9.5e-15 |
| bootstrap + Min-KS/seeded/OTF, small digital | 14 of 233 | +8.9e-16 | 0 | +8.9e-16 |
| 4 bootstraps, ARK-class | 24 of 812 | +1.2e-13 | 0 | +1.2e-13 |

## 3. Loosely timed (temporal decoupling) against approximately timed: speed and accuracy

Workload: 4 bootstraps on the ARK-class design (812 HE ops). SimPy: 204 ms of wall-clock time.

| style | global quantum | wall-clock (median of 5) | delta cycles | horizon | horizon vs SimPy | ops that differ from SimPy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AT | - | 329.5 ms | 35,421 | 55.7134 ms | +1.25e-13 | 0 |
| LT | 0 | 43.7 ms | 19,761 | 55.7134 ms | +1.25e-13 | 24 |
| LT | 0.1 us | 44.0 ms | 19,761 | 55.7134 ms | +1.25e-13 | 24 |
| LT | 1 us | 44.7 ms | 19,651 | 55.7134 ms | +1.25e-13 | 24 |
| LT | 10 us | 45.1 ms | 17,202 | 56.1586 ms | +7.99e-03 | 810 |
| LT | 100 us | 41.7 ms | 6,675 | 57.2754 ms | +2.80e-02 | 810 |
| LT | 1000 us | 42.6 ms | 3,605 | 57.7196 ms | +3.60e-02 | 810 |

LT books units and the HBM channel in the order processes call them; with a quantum, a process books resources up to a quantum ahead of simulated time, before others that would have asked earlier.
